featureReadiness.name: Institutional sign-in
featureReadiness.detail: Named accounts, assigned role permissions and protected writes are enabled. Business approvals require the assigned business role.

featureReadiness.name: External funding discovery
featureReadiness.detail: Configured official sources are scanned automatically when enabled. Calls are matched against NHRC and researcher expertise; eligibility requires review.

featureReadiness.name: NHRC eGMS Assistant
featureReadiness.detail: Free register summaries are enabled. Generative AI is optional and requires a connected model; summaries do not perform internet searches.

featureReadiness.name: Email notifications and task reminders
featureReadiness.detail: Email mode: BREVO. Automatic task reminders: enabled. Superadmin controls channels and role audiences in Communications Control.

featureReadiness.name: Donor submission and accounting connections
featureReadiness.detail: No external donor submission, bank payment or ERP posting connection is configured. These optional integrations do not block training workflows.

featureReadiness.name: Training workspace
featureReadiness.detail: Available features are open according to assigned permissions. Institutional production acceptance and external system connections remain separate decisions; this panel is status information, not an access lock.

newResearcherExternalInboxDelivery: Requires actual researcher addresses; synthetic addresses are blocked in live mode
